name: Disable Timer Coalescing
description: Disables timer coalescing to favor more immediate scheduling behavior on some systems, which may affect background task timing.

description_i18n.en: Disables timer coalescing to favor more immediate scheduling behavior on some systems, which may affect background task timing.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Timer-Verzögerung für sofortiges Zeitplanverhalten auf einigen Systemen; dies kann das Timing von Hintergrundaufgaben beeinflussen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la coalescence des temporisateurs pour favoriser un comportement de planification plus immédiat sur certains systèmes, ce qui peut affecter le timing des tâches en arrière-plan.

warnings.title: Experimental setting applied
warnings.message: This tweak applies an experimental registry change that alters how Windows schedules background timers; results vary by system

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value CoalescingTimerInterval at HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager to a DWord of 0
